{{Quote|Rest assured, my dear Moff, there is positively ''no'' treasonous activity on Shownar.|Oro Freatt|<ref name="GG9" />}}
'''Shownar''' was a paradise [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near the [[Torch Nebula/Legends|Torch Nebula]]. At night, the planet was illuminated by the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. Wind blowing through the [[vertag crystal]]s created the [[Shownar Lullaby]]. It was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] planet, though ''de facto'' ruled by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Oro Freatt]].

==Description==
Shownar was located in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the same name in the [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was in close proximity to the [[Torch Nebula/Legends|Torch Nebula]], and as a result its night sky was illuminated by [[Color/Legends|red]] and blue light from the celestial oddity.<ref name="GG9" />

Shownar itself consisted of three large landmasses composed entirely of a rare form of [[vertag crystal]]. These crystals formed spires several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] tall. At high altitudes, wind rushing between the spires created a ghostly harmonic wave known as the [[Shownar Lullaby]].<ref name="GG9" />
